Start with the decision the analysis needs to support.
Separate verified evidence, estimates and assumptions in every recommendation.
Ask who owns the outcome after the project team leaves.
Make trade-offs visible before stakeholders debate solutions.
Trace important work from strategy to measure, requirement and verification.
Check how a proposed change affects operations, controls, data and support.
Escalate with options and a clear decision request.
Use a baseline with an agreed population, formula, period and source.
